decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Site-Location Plan 569-P-1 01Existing Ground Floor Plan 569-P-100 01Existing First Floor Plan 569-P-101 01Existing Loft Plan 569-P-102 01Existing Roof Plan 569-P-103 01Existing East Elevation 569-P-104 01Existing South Elevation 569-P-105 01Existing West Elevation 569-P-106 01Existing Section AA 569-P-107 01Proposed Ground Floor Plan 569-P-201 01Proposed First Floor Plan 569-P-202 01Proposed Loft Plan 569-P-203 01Proposed Roof Plan 569-P-204 01Proposed East Elevation 569-P-205 01Proposed South Elevation 569-P-206 01Proposed West Elevation 569-P-207 01Proposed Section AA 569-P-208 01Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match the existing building or as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.
description: New rear ground floor windows/folding doors, reconstruction of existing rear extension roof to facilitate roof lights, roller blinds to rear windows, anti-heat blinds to existing roof lights, new external render and relocation of existing AC unit to external rear.
